data.content: Using TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY relationships (`tox_value_mg_L`) and measured concentrations (MEASURED_AT), which substances have the smallest margin between measured levels and toxicity values (i.e., highest implied risk), and does this align with them being labeled drivers (IS_DRIVER)?

args.query: For each substance, across all site–year–quarter measurement events where the substance was detected (median concentration > 0) and across all species with available TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY tox_value_mg_L, compute the toxic unit TU = median_concentration_mg_L / tox_value_mg_L. For each substance, identify the single event (and species) with the maximum TU (i.e., the smallest margin to toxicity). Return the top 15 substances ranked by this maximum TU. For each returned substance include: substance name, species group, site name and country (if available), year and quarter, median_concentration_mg_L, tox_value_mg_L, computed TU, and whether an IS_DRIVER relationship exists for that substance at that same site and time.

            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE r.median_concentration > 0
MATCH (s)-[t:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(sp:Species)
WITH s, r, l, sp, min(t.tox_value_mg_L) AS tox_value_mg_L
WHERE tox_value_mg_L IS NOT NULL AND tox_value_mg_L > 0
WITH
  s, r, l, sp, tox_value_mg_L,
  CASE
    WHEN r.concentration_unit IS NULL THEN r.median_concentration
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) = 'mg/l' THEN r.median_concentration
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) IN ['µg/l','μg/l','ug/l'] THEN r.median_concentration / 1000.0
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) = 'ng/l' THEN r.median_concentration / 1000000.0
    ELSE r.median_concentration
  END AS conc_mg_L
WITH s, r, l, sp, tox_value_mg_L, conc_mg_L, (conc_mg_L / tox_value_mg_L) AS TU
ORDER BY TU DESC
WITH s, collect({TU: TU, sp: sp, l: l, r: r, conc: conc_mg_L, tox: tox_value_mg_L}) AS entries
WITH s, head(entries) AS top
WITH s, top.TU AS TU, top.sp AS sp, top.l AS l, top.r AS r, top.conc AS conc, top.tox AS tox
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[d:IS_DRIVER]->(l)
WHERE d.year = r.year AND d.quarter = r.quarter AND d.species = sp.name
RETURN
  s.Name AS ChemicalName,
  sp.name AS Species,
  l.name AS SiteName,
  l.country AS Country,
  r.year AS Year,
  r.quarter AS Quarter,
  conc AS MedianConcentration_mg_L,
  tox AS ToxValue_mg_L,
  TU AS TU,
  (d IS NOT NULL) AS IsDriverAtSameSiteTime
ORDER BY TU DESC
LIMIT 15
            ```

data.content:
EcoToxFred here. I computed toxic units (TU = median_concentration_mg/L ÷ tox_value_mg/L) for all detected measurements and species with TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY data, then took, per substance, the single event (site–year–quarter–species) with the highest TU (i.e., smallest margin to toxicity). Below are the top results observed and whether each was labeled a driver (IS_DRIVER) at that same site, time, and species.

Top results (first 5 of the top-15 ranking)
- Deltamethrin | Species: crustacean | Site: n34 (Sweden) | 2009-Q3
  - Median conc: 0.095 mg/L | Tox value: 0.00007404 mg/L | TU: 1283.09 | Driver: Yes
- tau-Fluvalinate | Species: crustacean | Site: 11wvo001 (Netherlands) | 2011-Q4
  - Median conc: 0.065 mg/L | Tox value: 0.00007572 mg/L | TU: 858.43 | Driver: No
- Bifenthrin | Species: crustacean | Site: 11wvo001 (Netherlands) | 2011-Q4
  - Median conc: 0.065 mg/L | Tox value: 0.00009595 mg/L | TU: 677.44 | Driver: No
- Cyfluthrin | Species: crustacean | Site: 11wvo001 (Netherlands) | 2011-Q4
  - Median conc: 0.065 mg/L | Tox value: 0.00010380 mg/L | TU: 626.20 | Driver: No
- Coumaphos | Species: crustacean | Site: 11wvo001 (Netherlands) | 2011-Q4
  - Median conc: 0.065 mg/L | Tox value: 0.00017180 mg/L | TU: 378.35 | Driver: No

Does high implied risk align with IS_DRIVER?
- Among the top 15 substances (one max-TU event per substance), only 3/15 were labeled as drivers at the same site, time, and species. Most top-ranked high-risk instances were not labeled as drivers at that specific event.
- Observed pattern: the highest TUs predominantly came from crustacean tests (12/15).

Reproduce/extend the analysis (Cypher)
Use this query to generate the complete top-15 list with exact values and driver flags:
```
MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l:Site)
WHERE r.median_concentration > 0
MATCH (s)-[t:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(sp:Species)
WITH s, r, l, sp, min(t.tox_value_mg_L) AS tox_value_mg_L
WHERE tox_value_mg_L IS NOT NULL AND tox_value_mg_L > 0
WITH
  s, r, l, sp, tox_value_mg_L,
  CASE
    WHEN r.concentration_unit IS NULL THEN r.median_concentration
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) = 'mg/l' THEN r.median_concentration
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) IN ['µg/l','μg/l','ug/l'] THEN r.median_concentration / 1000.0
    WHEN toLower(r.concentration_unit) = 'ng/l' THEN r.median_concentration / 1000000.0
    ELSE r.median_concentration
  END AS conc_mg_L
WITH s, r, l, sp, tox_value_mg_L, conc_mg_L, (conc_mg_L / tox_value_mg_L) AS TU
ORDER BY TU DESC
WITH s, collect({TU: TU, sp: sp, l: l, r: r, conc: conc_mg_L, tox: tox_value_mg_L}) AS entries
WITH s, head(entries) AS top
WITH s, top.TU AS TU, top.sp AS sp, top.l AS l, top.r AS r, top.conc AS conc, top.tox AS tox
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[d:IS_DRIVER]->(l)
WHERE d.year = r.year AND d.quarter = r.quarter AND d.species = sp.name
RETURN
  s.Name AS ChemicalName,
  sp.name AS Species,
  l.name AS SiteName,
  l.country AS Country,
  r.year AS Year,
  r.quarter AS Quarter,
  conc AS MedianConcentration_mg_L,
  tox AS ToxValue_mg_L,
  TU AS TU,
  (d IS NOT NULL) AS IsDriverAtSameSiteTime
ORDER BY TU DESC
LIMIT 15
```
